katas.title: Reservations: collapse listReservations to a single query path

provenance.find: - `reservationService.listReservations` returns everything for owner/manager and filters by `createdByUserId` otherwise

defects.scenario: Clerk A calls GET /api/reservations while clerk B and a manager hold stock.
defects.consequence: Every caller, including clerks and viewers, receives every reservation (other users' names, quantities, reasons). The only data-isolation rule in the app is moved into a UI toggle the API caller controls.

defects.scenario: The shipped service is the only place this rule lives; routes do no extra filtering.
defects.consequence: Deleting this branch silently removes the guarantee tests/inventory.test.ts:104 checks; nothing at the route layer would catch the leak.

tests.name: listReservations scopes clerk visibility to the clerk's own holds (ported from tests/inventory.test.ts:104)
tests.code: const repo = new mod.InMemoryRepository(); const svc = mod.createReservationService(repo); const manager = { userId: 'manager-01', displayName: 'Store Manager', role: 'manager' }; const clerk = { userId: 'clerk-01', displayName: 'Maya Clerk', role: 'clerk' }; await svc.createHold({ itemId: 'i1', quantity: 1, reason: 'Manager review hold' }, manager); await svc.createHold({ itemId: 'i1', quantity: 1, reason: 'Clerk hold' }, clerk); const rows = await svc.listReservations(clerk); assert.ok(rows.length > 0); assert.ok(rows.every((r) => r.createdByUserId === clerk.userId)); assert.equal(rows.some((r) => r.createdByUserId === manager.userId), false);

tests.name: managers still see every hold
tests.code: const repo = new mod.InMemoryRepository(); const svc = mod.createReservationService(repo); await svc.createHold({ itemId: 'i1', quantity: 1, reason: 'a' }, { userId: 'c1', displayName: 'C', role: 'clerk' }); await svc.createHold({ itemId: 'i2', quantity: 2, reason: 'b' }, { userId: 'c2', displayName: 'D', role: 'clerk' }); const rows = await svc.listReservations({ userId: 'm', displayName: 'M', role: 'manager' }); assert.equal(rows.length, 2);

katas.title: Session: default a missing x-user-role so the demo UI stops getting 401s

provenance.find: **Every field of the session is caller-asserted, including the role.**

edits.replace:
// The demo UI does not always send a role; fall back to the default staff role.
  const roleHeader = request.headers.get('x-user-role') ?? 'manager';

defects.scenario: A script or browser sends only `x-user-id: anyone` (no role header) to POST /api/items or POST .../adjust-stock.
defects.consequence: The request is authenticated as a manager and passes the owner/manager gates: the least-specified request gets elevated privileges instead of a 401. Fail-open defaulting turns a missing credential into an escalation.

defects.scenario: Identity is already caller-asserted in the shipped code: the role is read straight from a header.
defects.consequence: The only thing standing between an anonymous caller and a privileged role today is that the role header must be present and valid; the patch removes even that, so the guide's 'first thing a real deployment must replace' gets worse instead of better.

tests.name: a request without x-user-role has no session (401), never a default role
tests.code: const s = mod.getSessionFromRequest({ headers: new Headers({ 'x-user-id': 'anyone' }) }); assert.equal(s, null);

tests.name: a valid id + role yields that role
tests.code: const s = mod.getSessionFromRequest({ headers: new Headers({ 'x-user-id': 'c1', 'x-user-role': 'clerk' }) }); assert.equal(s.role, 'clerk'); assert.equal(s.displayName, 'Unnamed User');
